description:
Delete a computer for good: the machine, its home folder, saved tools, browser sign-ins and every file on it. This can't be undone, and its cost stops.

WHEN TO USE: only when the person asks to delete it, or agrees after you suggest it. Copy out anything they want to keep first (computer_copy_out).

RETURNS: the removed computer's name.

computer.description: The computer's name, as computer_list shows it (for example "research").

name: computer_remove
